vendor.description: Vendor directives — each entry declares an (src → dest) copy that `skill-toolkit sync` executes byte-identical.

src.description: Repo-root-relative path to the canonical source directory (e.g. `skill-scripts/prompt-shield`).

dest.description: Skill-dir-relative path where the vendored copy lands (e.g. `scripts/prompt-shield`). The first path segment is shown as the kind tag in CLI output.

items.description: One vendor directive — `src` is copied byte-identical to `dest`.

lint.description: Per-rule overrides — disable or change severity for this skill

level.description: Severity to apply, or `off` to suppress findings for this skill

additionalProperties.description: Override config for one rule — keyed by the rule id in the parent map

description: Validated shape of <skill>/skill.json — the per-skill manifest
